assumptions.statement: Official exact SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons are missing from the public package; provisional_boundaries.geojson is in use with official_boundary=false and geometry_role=provisional_constraint.
assumptions.impact: Areas/lengths recomputed in EPSG:4548 are intake/discussion values only and must not be treated as official redlines or precise formal scoring areas.

assumptions.statement: Industry AI PoC center, signal-yellow real-time light array, honor wall/milestones, and annual pilgrimage events are conceptual proposals / reference schemes for professional deepening — not approved facilities, funded programs, or operating commitments.
assumptions.impact: Narrative, geometry nodes, and metrics counts describe design intent; they do not claim built status, government endorsement, or guaranteed operations.

assumptions.statement: When organizer-supplied official polygons and controls arrive, site boundary, key areas, land use, roads, green/public space, buildings, phasing, and metrics.json must be fully recalculated and matrices re-checked.
assumptions.impact: Current metric values are provisional recomputations; replacement of a single file without full recalculation is not allowed.

assumptions.statement: No statutory FAR, building height, density, setback, road redline, ownership, or municipal capacity claims are made; floor_area_ratio and total_floor_area_sqm remain unknown pending official controls.
assumptions.impact: Building footprints and land-use patches are design concepts only and cannot be read as regulatory detailed-plan determinations.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, heritage protection lines, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before any statutory use.
assumptions.impact: Package is reviewable as a formal AI submission for disclosed provisional boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.
